title: Day 682 — Peso Strengthens to 16.98/USD as Sheinbaum Confirms Tamaulipas Hospital Tour
detail: On August 14, 2026 (Day 682, Friday), Sheinbaum noted the peso trading at 16.98 per US dollar and said she expects H2 2026 growth to strengthen as previously delayed public works — held up mainly by bureaucratic bottlenecks — begin construction: 'Each month is going to be better.' She also confirmed a weekend work tour to Tamaulipas with Governor Américo Villarreal to inaugurate two new hospitals (ISSSTE and IMSS-Bienestar), review hydraulic works, and meet with 'Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro' participants.

media.caption: Sheinbaum's August 14 mañanera: peso at 16.98/USD, Tamaulipas hospital tour confirmed
